subject: Vendor proposal: Annotate AI — prompt eval & data labeling pilot
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Ramos <natalie@annotate.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Prompt eval + labeling pilot — request for proposal and SOC2

Hi Natalie,

Quick intro — I'm Sergio on the platform partnerships team at Redwood. We're evaluating a short pilot to validate prompt evaluation metrics and produce ~5k labeled examples (mixed prompt / answer pairs) to feed our regression tests. Target scope: 6 weeks, sampled from live-hosted traffic (redacted) for the evals and a separate synthetic set for labeling.

Could you send over: 1) a brief SOW and line-item quote for a 6-week pilot; 2) SOC2 evidence or a redacted report; 3) a short note on your data handling and retention (where data is processed, whether you persist raw inputs, encryption in transit/at-rest); and 4) lead times for onboarding and a sample deliverable.

We have security/compliance review loops, so SOC2 + a short ATO checklist will speed procurement. CC'ing Neha (security) and Grace (ops) for scope/PO guidance.

Timing: we'd like the proposal by EOD Friday (7/3) if possible.

Thanks — Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
(415) 555-0134

From: Natalie Ramos <natalie@annotate.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Annotate AI Sales <sales@annotate.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Jul 2026 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Prompt eval + labeling pilot — request for proposal and SOC2

Hi Sergio — great to meet you. Thanks for the clear brief. Please find attached our proposed SOW and quote for a 6-week pilot:

- Pilot scope: prompt evaluation (2,500 pairs) + human labeling (5,000 examples) with labeler QA and 1 pass of adjudication.
- Timeline: kickoff within 5 business days of PO; delivery in 6 weeks from kickoff with interim status every 2 weeks.
- Pricing: $18,000 fixed for the pilot (SOW line-items in attached PDF).
- Deliverables: CSV of labels, QA report, brief onboarding doc, and a short evaluation notebook with reproducible sampling.

Attachments: Annotate_SOW_v1.docx, Annotate_Quote_Q3-26.pdf, SOC2_report_redacted.pdf

Data handling summary: we process inputs in AWS us-west-2, do not persist raw unredacted inputs beyond the project (default retention 30 days unless otherwise specified), and encrypt data in transit and at rest. We can add an additional redaction pass at labeling time if you require it. Legal has been looped in for standard terms.

If that looks good I can send a DocuSign SOW and invoice; otherwise, happy to iterate.

Best,
Natalie Ramos
Partnerships — Annotate AI
natalie@annotate.ai

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Jul 2026 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Prompt eval + labeling pilot — request for proposal and SOC2

Thanks for the packet Natalie — quick questions for procurement/security before we sign:

1) The SOC2 redaction looks fine at a high level; can you confirm which subservice orgs the report covers (processing / hosting / vendor mgmt)? We need that explicitly called out.
2) Does Annotate retain raw inputs (pre-redaction) for troubleshooting? If so, for how long and who has access?
3) We'd like to add a PII redaction step in the labeling workflow (configurable). Can that be included in the SOW and pricing quote as an optional add-on?
4) Liability and indemnity: what is your standard cap? We may need to push for a commercial cap aligned to the pilot value.

If you can answer the above and send a revised SOW that calls out the redaction option, we can route to procurement and generate a PO.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

From: Natalie Ramos <natalie@annotate.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Vendor Legal <legal@annotate.ai>
Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Prompt eval + labeling pilot — request for proposal and SOC2

Hi Neha — thanks for the thorough questions; answers below and updated notes attached.

1) SOC2 scope: covers processing and hosting (Annotate subservice orgs: data-processing, label-ops) and vendor mgmt controls. Redacted report attached (SOC2_report_redacted.pdf).
2) Retention: by default we retain pre-redaction inputs for 14 days for troubleshooting, only accessible to senior label ops and data engineers; we can shorten this to 7 days for regulated pilots and enable access logs.
3) PII redaction add-on: yes — separate line-item in SOW (estimated +$2,000 for the pilot). We've added an optional checkbox and cost in the revised SOW (attached).
4) Liability cap: standard is $100,000; for a pilot we can set a commercial cap equal to pilot fees ($18,000) upon written request. Vendor Legal is on copy if you want nonstandard language.

Attachments: Annotate_SOW_v1.docx (updated with redaction option), Annotate_Quote_Q3-26.pdf, SOC2_report_redacted.pdf

Let me know if you want a short call to walk through the SOW.

Best,
Natalie Ramos
Partnerships — Annotate AI

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>

Sergio
